places.name: The Wakewatch
places.epithet: A constant watch on the southern and eastern horizons
places.text: The tower on the headland's crown from which Hinckburgh's weather-readers watch the sea, day and night, for anything blowing in.
places.source: Of Stormwake, the Open Harbor of the East

places.name: The Signal Mast
places.text: Where Hinckburgh exchanges signals with Skyloom's Loomwardens across the island: cordially, now, though Hinckburgh has never entirely forgiven the Western Gale.
places.source: Of Stormwake, the Open Harbor of the East

places.name: The Readers' Hall
places.text: Where the weather-readers keep their logs, their barometers and their grudges.

places.name: The Gale Stone
places.text: A marker stone carved with the names of those the Western Gale took from Hinckburgh, and, at the bottom, in smaller letters, the word Skyloom.
places.source: Of Stormwake, the Open Harbor of the East

places.name: The Pilots' House
places.epithet: Where the Lane leaves the Wakewater
places.text: Home of the pilots who take ships out where the Caer Veynese Lane leaves the Wakewater for the open sea.
places.source: Of Stormwake, the Open Harbor of the East

places.name: Lantern Square
places.text: The town's square, where a lantern is hung for every ship the Wakewatch has seen go out and not yet seen come back.

places.name: The Hundred Steps
places.text: The stair-streets climbing from the harbour to the hilltop; there are rather more than a hundred.
